records.description_rewritten: Saughton Park is a large civic park in west Edinburgh, with formal rose gardens, a conservatory, sports grounds and a skateboard park. An adult directory lists both Saughton Park and Saughton Park/Car Park, but does not supply a recent first-person encounter for either. The council confirms the formal walled garden closes at 16:00 during October–March; ordinary outdoor grounds and car park may have different access. City-run winter toilets have their own restricted times. Historic directory labels must not be taken as evidence of late-night opening or a currently active cruising scene.
records.location_identity: Saughton Park and Gardens at Balgreen Road EH11 3BQ, Edinburgh; source 8 includes possibly distinct 'Saughton Park-Car park' sublocation not proven identical.
records.access_conditions: Formal walled garden in winter 09:00–16:00, conservatory 09:00–15:15 weekdays and 09:00–13:45 weekends. Council winter toilets courtyard weekdays 09:30–16:00, Winter Gardens weekdays 09:00–15:15/weekends 09:00–13:30. Skate park and outdoor paths separate; restrictions and public recreation apply.

records.description_rewritten: Royal Terrace Gardens is a landscaped green space on the eastern slope of Calton Hill beside Royal Terrace, Regent Road and London Road. CruisingGays lists it as an Edinburgh cruising park but marks its location as needing a check. A new restaurant, The Cottage at Royal Terrace, opened in the historic gardener's cottage and is reached from London Road through the garden path, confirming the grounds' active public and commercial use in 2026. It is not the same as Calton Hill's summit or London Road Gardens, and no dated cruising visitor report was verified.
records.location_identity: Royal Terrace Gardens near 1 Royal Terrace Gardens / London Road EH7 5DX, Edinburgh. Distinct from Calton Hill summit and London Road Gardens.
records.access_conditions: Landscaped public green space and approach to staffed restaurant. Specific garden opening/gate rules not independently verified, and a restaurant's evening hours do not imply full garden accessibility or sex-on-premises permission.

records.description_rewritten: Princes Street Gardens is Edinburgh's central historic park directly below the Castle, with different eastern and western sections and several public restrooms. CruisingGays records the gardens generally; Gays-Cruising indexes 'Toilets Prince's Street Garden', and two separate Squirt records identify Ross Bandstand and West public toilets. These may be facilities within the same gardens but should not be collapsed into a single exact pin. The City Council says the gardens open at 07:00 and close at 18:00 from 26 October to 31 December, with west gates starting to close at 17:00 and east at 17:15. Squirt's list showed a recent relative reply for Ross Bandstand as of 6 November 2026, but its detail page was inaccessible and the reply is not proof of an encounter.
records.location_identity: East and West Princes Street Gardens on Princes Street EH2 2HG; Ross Bandstand toilets (source7 Squirt 51176) and West toilets (74040) different physical facilities, cannot treat as equivalent source records.
records.access_conditions: Gardens open 07:00–18:00 during current Oct26–Dec31 season; entry closure begins west 17:00, east 17:15. Council lists winter toilet Ross Bandstand 10:00–19:00 and West 10:00–20:00; this divergence from park gate hours needs confirmation of after-gate routes, not assumption of entry. Public restrooms under operator supervision and consent/privacy constraints.

records.description_rewritten: Marine Drive and Silverknowes Promenade run along the Forth north of Edinburgh. CruisingGays lists 'Marine Drive (Sliverknowes Promenade)' as an outdoor area; Gays-Cruising separately describes Silverknowes Woods by a road ending in woodland, with zero visitor comments, so the entries may be adjacent but not the same pin. A major vehicle access change matters: Silverknowes Road between Parkway and Marine Drive is under a prolonged council closure, and Lothian Buses permanently moved service 29's terminus from the promenade to Silverknowes Parkway in September 2026. The coastal pedestrian promenade may remain accessible; roadworks do not automatically mean the whole shoreline has closed. No recent confirmed cruising encounters.
records.location_identity: Marine Drive / Silverknowes Promenade, Edinburgh North Shore; adjacent Silverknowes Woods source1 near roadway end, exact site alignment unconfirmed.
records.access_conditions: Silverknowes Road vehicular section to Marine Drive has been closed for major repairs from November 2025 into 2027 (council temporary order). Lothian Bus 29 no longer ends at promenade since Sep13 2026. Check signed access; shoreline footpaths/parking may have separate restrictions.

records.description_rewritten: Braid Hills Drive rises across the hills to the south of Edinburgh, bordered by public bridle paths, viewpoint areas and golf courses. A cruising directory lists a 'Braid Hills Drive Car Park' but has no dated visitor report or verified exact parking bay; the city park directory confirms the road and hills but does not identify the source's claimed area. A separate official golf operator advertises a free car park, yet that is associated with its course and need not be the directory's roadside viewpoint parking. Avoid equating adjacent public trail parking, golf club facilities and a private adult location.
records.location_identity: Braid Hills Drive public viewpoint/roadside area EH10 6JZ Edinburgh, specific car park on drive unverified; distinct from Golf Course visitor parking and Observatory car park for Blackford Hill.
records.access_conditions: Public Braid Hills horse paths and walking routes coexist with active golf courses and club grounds. Golf operator's seasonal hours (Nov roughly 08:20–15:30) and car park do not establish public road parking access or sex permissions. Use lawful laybys only; steep/muddy paths and shared bridle route.
